text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—The stars twinkle.
Tirelessly circling the same path... However.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
No two nights are ever the same.
No two shines are ever alike.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Umamusume run.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Treading the same path without growing tired of it... and yet.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
No two races are ever the same.
No two days will ever be alike.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Only the earth knows.
The depth of the hoofprints... and how they overlap.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What will become of us?
What awaits at the end of the course...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
“—Everything is already right before our eyes.
Let us begin.”

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —A "legend" that will be passed down through the ages.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just before the start of "Dream Fest"—
all of Japan was buzzing with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, about the upcoming "Dream Fest"!
Legend Umamusume are gonna be there too, right?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! By the time I started watching races,
she had already retired... so this is super moving!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Woooow!
So the race will be shown on this giant screen!

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's a festival, right!
Let's watch, let's watch!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
<nickname>!!
Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: "'Watching via stream, but it's gonna be super hype! Let's witness a legend being born together!' ...And send."

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, an instant reply! Heheh...
Wait, from overseas!? Translate, translate...!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko Fan
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaa...! HAI SEIKOOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Child
text_block_list.text:
Wawa, what a lively crowd!
Dad, over here, over here――

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text: —...I knew it, it wasn't a dream...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
"Speed Symboli's name is here!
...Ngh...!"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Child
text_block_list.text: Huh, Dad...?

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
—...Hahaha! No, it's nothing.
A race is meant to be watched for the long haul...!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's cheer together!
For our beloved—Uma Musume!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"...To find myself amidst these cheers once again.
Fate truly is... a mysterious thing, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
You two,
this is no time to be soaking it in!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
The fans are waiting.
Let's head out with our brightest smiles♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: You too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"Please have the best time,
and cheer for us as loud as you can!"

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
The "essence of Umamusume racing"...
Its pride.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Allow me
to show you as well.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Today's victory likely won't be
recorded in the history of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
However... she will undoubtedly be
etched into the fans' memories.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: I believe that this passion... will become the seeds of the future.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer...
Deliver the message to her.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Are you prepared to stand alongside us?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right before the race—
My eyes meet with <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――I have a feeling. Today's race is...
sure to become legendary.
